name: Zhuque-2E
location_str: Launch Area 96A @ Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center, CHN
slot_a_text: Launch Area 96A is up to 4 launches this year, and 9 since its first in 2022. Its previous launch was 29 days earlier.
slot_b_text: LandSpace's 5th launch of the year, 13th all time. Worldwide, it is attempt number 242 of the year.
rocket_fact: A spacecraft in low Earth orbit travels at roughly 17,500 mph (28,000 km/h).
